aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab was founded by Dominic Bonini, who made the Village Foodie service to find out which food trucks were coming to his village. It’s a small company that he runs himself.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.hatchgrab: The more food trucks I studied, the more strongly I thought they deserve better tools: something made for a business that operates in a different place every day, not for a restaurant with a fixed address. That’s why I founded HatchGrab.
aboutPage.story.small: It’s a small company, and I run it myself. When you get in touch, the reply comes from me, not from a support queue.
aboutPage.story.village: I live in a village. Food trucks visit the village, but I never knew which of them was coming or when, unless I dug the information out of Facebook.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: So I made the Village Foodie service, where you can easily see which food trucks are coming to nearby villages.

featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers order for a future day or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.advanced_reporting: Break down sales by date range, item and event and see what really sells.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — you don’t need to confirm each one separately.

featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: Attach a buzzer number to an order when you give a buzzer to a customer, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.

featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with their own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a real-time kitchen screen and the only way to keep taking orders when the connection drops.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a time slot is full, customers can’t choose it.

featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Like WhatsApp automatic replies, but for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens — at the counter and in the kitchen — all showing the same orders in real time.

featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a deadline for items that must be ordered in advance.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map and have their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule automatically — from your website or a picture you already post on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Send customers a text message automatically when the order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your design — we add the dates, places and times automatically for every week and event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item sold out with one tap — it shows greyed out to customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity and it counts down as orders come in, and the item is marked sold out automatically.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, so no separate card terminal is needed.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print kitchen tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose a time slot for collection, which evens out demand over the whole trading session.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders at the food truck, with payments on your own card terminal.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run a trading session from the browser of any phone, tablet or laptop.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how much you can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the food truck — and the card terminal you already take payments with.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume a fixed address, reliable wifi and the same opening hours every week. You are somewhere new every week, at different times, and the mobile network is weak or missing altogether. HatchGrab was made for exactly this.
landing.does.offlineBody: If the connection drops, online orders pause automatically so customers can’t place orders you don’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the design you already use on Facebook or Instagram. We add the dates, places and times to it, ready to share — every week or every day.
landing.does.postsTitle: Automate your Facebook and Instagram posts
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers order in advance and choose a collection time. Fewer queues, and the food is ready when they arrive.
landing.does.title: Made for food trucks, not restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you this evening?” “What desserts do you have?” Your WhatsApp is answered while you drive to the selling spot or stand at the grill — based on your own menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you this evening?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon your WhatsApp will be answered while you drive to the selling spot or stand at the grill. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
landing.final.lede: Upload a photo or screenshot of your menu and we’ll turn it into a working ordering page you can try in under 60 seconds. Your items, your prices. No registration, no card, nothing to install. Look first, decide afterwards.
